text:
maria: quick sync on SDK surface for pagination + retries. thinking about two shapes: tiny stateless bookmark vs Session object.
eli: ops note: if clients persist bookmarks they can rotate server internals freely. server-side sessions buy dedupe but add state.
zane: i vote for opaque bookmark (base64url) + optional Session wrapper in SDKs. keep server compatible with both.
kai: duplicates on retry are the big worry. we should define an idempotency hint header clients can send when resuming.
maria: proposal: bookmarks are opaque strings prefixed with `bm:v1:`; server accepts `bm:v*:`. SDKs expose `bookmark` param and a `Session` class for long-lived runs.
docs-bot: protocol additions: `Grace-Period` header (seconds) for short reconnect windows, `Retry-Mode: session|stateless` header, and `Idempotency-Hint` optional.
eli: defaults suggested: transport backoff 200ms->2s, session grace default 5s. SDKs should map casing per language.
zane: example Python surfaces planned:
``n# simple
for p in client.paginate(q, bookmark=maybe):
    handle(p)

# session
s = client.start_session()
for p in s.paginate(q):
    handle(p)
```
kai: TS should mirror with camelCase and lightweight Session when needed.
maria: errors: expired bookmark -> 410 + Retry-From header; malformed -> 400. SDK to raise clear exception with suggestion.
docs-bot: telemetry: emit session_start, bookmark_issued, bookmark_resumed, bookmark_expired as minimal events.
maria: action items: i'll write RFC draft with snippets and migration notes. kai/zane will prototype Python Session. quick thumbs if this sounds right. :thumbsup:
